Full summary: 2026-10-06: merged fix/repo-ids as 0f9fd985 and rebuilt the trial worktree there; confirmed from source that `twining sync --remote` never reaches the Git carrier; recorded the operator-surface defect list (DN46) as go/no-go failures to report, not fix; launched operator-docs-finalize to turn the audit notebooks into self-contained guides; paused the trial build with the harness WIP committed on branch foundation-trial; reordered to docs then final report.
Decisions: Chose to report the operator-surface defects (sync never uses Git, no rebuild caller, migrate does not finalize on hook-era ids, rollback double-records, no tombstone surface) as failures with reproductions rather than fix them — each is lane 02/03 code and together they are a material scope expansion (DN46); Chose to rewrite the five operator docs as self-contained guides over committing the audit notebooks — their evidence citations pointed at a wiped scratchpad and an operator cannot act on 1300 lines of pass narrative (D59); Chose to deliver operator docs and the final report before more trial work, pausing the trial at its current build — the adoption gates fail on migration/operations regardless of trial results and any result at this SHA would need re-running after the fixes (D60); Chose Opus for workflow agents over the session model — the Fable usage limit killed agents mid-run twice (2026-09-16, 2026-09-20)
